preview_heading: Barbados Tridents vs Jamaica Kingsmen: a place in Qualifier 2 at stake
preview: Barbados Tridents face Jamaica Kingsmen in the CPL 2026 Eliminator at Kensington Oval on September 16. Play starts at 7:00pm Barbados time. The winner advances to Qualifier 2, while the losing team is eliminated from the tournament.
preview_detail: Barbados Tridents and Jamaica Kingsmen are confirmed as the Eliminator participants. The toss result and confirmed playing XIs will be added when announced on match day.
